answer: In this PoA design, an agent identity is derived from a remotely attested enclave whose signed quote binds its public key to MRENCLAVE, so verifiers accept only code running in the measured enclave and approved kernel. Copying a key, VM, or hollow software image cannot reproduce the attested secret; cloning an identity therefore requires another genuine, provisioned enclave on physical silicon, not virtual-machine duplication. An atlas of valid measurements rejects unauthorized replicas.
